title: Yellow Fluffy Jamaican Yam Flatbread
description: A rich and fluffy flatbread featuring Jamaican yam, olive oil, and a long-fermentation dough, perfect for a comforting snack or side dish. This egg-free-friendly recipe is great for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the grated yam, olive oil, yeast, and warm water, and let it sit for 24 hours to allow for long fermentation.
After the fermentation period, add the flour, salt, and sugar to the bowl and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 2 hours.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a flat disc using a rolling pin or your hands.
Cook the flatbreads for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and fluffy.
